name: ask-the-docs
title_zh: 问 Supabase 文档库怎么改，先答架构再答代码
tagline_zh: 别再翻遍 apps/docs 猜结构。它按官方架构图、构建流程和评审笔记回答你，改前先问它，少走三次弯路。
tagline_en: Stop guessing the docs app's structure. It answers with official architecture, build pipeline, and review.
desc_en: Answer questions about the Supabase docs app (apps/docs) using documented architecture, build pipeline, and review-pattern notes, and apply feature-design principles (codebase reuse, coding minimalism) when proposing or critiquing changes. Use when the user asks "how does X work in the docs app?", "where does Y live?", "is this approach OK for the docs app?", or before writing non-trivial changes
why_zh: 机制差异：它强制先讲 documented 架构与构建管线，再谈改动，避免你凭局部印象乱改。
why_en: It forces architecture-first answers grounded in official docs, then applies reuse and minimalism—so you don't patch blindly or.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Supabase 仓库的 apps/docs 目录，不碰其他子应用；不执行代码或跑测试，只给建议。
limit_en: Only covers apps/docs in supabase/supabase; no code execution or tests—just advice. Out-of-scope questions get a nudge to other tools.
title_en: Ask how Supabase docs work, get architecture first
